title: निद्रा कथामा लैङ्गिकता {Gender in the Sleep Story}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख निद्रा कथामा लैङ्गिकताको अवस्था पहिल्याउनमा केन्द्रित छ । निद्राकथा नेपाल सरकार शिक्षा मन्त्रालय पाठ्यक्रम विकास केन्द्रद्वारा कक्षा नौ को अनिवार्य  नेपाली विषयको पाठ्यपुस्तकमा समावेश गरिएको ऐतिहासिक विषयवस्तुमा आधारित कथा हो ।  लैङ्गिक अध्ययनले कुनै साहित्यिक कृतिमा नारी, पुरुष तथा अन्य लिङ्गीहरुको सामाजिक,सांस्कृतिक अवस्थाको खोजी गर्दछ । यसले सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक दृष्टिले नारी, पुरुष तथा अन्यलिङ्गीहरुका बिचमा कुनै किसिमको भिन्नता हुनु हुँदैन भन्ने मान्यता राख्दछ । सन् १९६० को दशकपछि नारीवादी आन्दोलन विकसित हुँदै जाँदा लैङ्गिक चेतनाको विकास भएको पाइन्छ ।  लैङ्गिक अध्ययन अन्तर्गत नारीवाद, पितृसत्ता, सामाजिक लिङ्ग, लैङ्गिकता, पुलिङ्गता रसामाजिक लिङ्गभेद, शरीर राजनीति जस्ता विषय क्षेत्रहरु पर्दछन् । यस अध्ययन पत्रमा लैङ्गिक  अध्ययनको सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणा प्रस्तुत गर्दै निद्रा कथामा लैङ्गिकताको अवस्था कस्तो रहेको छ ? उक्त कथामा पात्रहरुको लैङ्गिक भूमिका कस्तो रहेको छ भन्ने कुराको खोजी गरिएको छ । अध्ययन पत्र तयार गर्नका लागि पुस्तकालय अध्ययनबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान पद्धतिको उपयोग गर्दै तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन तथा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । निद्रा कथामा देखाइएको परिवेश राणा दरबारको हो । यस कथामा तत्कालीन समयमा सम्भ्रान्त वर्गीय परिवारमा  पनि पुरुष अहम् तथा प्रभुत्वका अगाडि नारीका आवाजलाई बेवास्ता गरिएको देख्न सकिन्छ ।  पात्रको प्रयोगमा पुरुष पात्रको उपस्थिति नारीका तुलनामा सशक्त देखाइएको छ । नारीको भूमिकालाई कम प्रभुत्वका दिइए पनि आफ्नो अस्तित्व र पहिचानका लागि उनी निर्भीक देखिएकीछिन् । यसरी लैङ्गिक चेतनाका दृष्टिले प्रस्तुत निद्रा कथा महत्वपूर्ण कथा हो भन्ने निष्कर्षमा पुगिएको छ ।
american_english: The present article focuses on identifying the state of gender in the story “Nidra.” The story “Nidra” is a narrative based on historical subject matter included by the Government of Nepal, Ministry of Education, Curriculum Development Center in the compulsory Nepali textbook for Class Nine. Gender studies explores the social and cultural condition of women, men, and other genders in a literary work. It maintains the premise that from a social and cultural standpoint, there should be no distinction of any kind among women, men, and other genders. With the development of the feminist movement after the 1960s, the emergence of gender consciousness is observed. Subject areas such as feminism, patriarchy, social gender, gender, masculinity and social gender discrimination, and body politics fall within gender studies. In this study paper, while presenting the theoretical concepts of gender studies, what is the state of gender in the story “Nidra”? An inquiry has been conducted into what the gender roles of the characters in the said story are like. To prepare the study paper, materials were collected through library research. Data collection and analysis were carried out using qualitative research methodology. The setting depicted in the story “Nidra” is the Rana palace. In this story, it can be seen that even in elite-class families of that era, women’s voices were disregarded in the face of male ego and dominance. In the deployment of characters, the presence of male characters is portrayed as stronger compared to women. Although the female role is accorded less dominance, she appears fearless in fighting for her existence and identity. In this way, the conclusion is reached that from the perspective of gender consciousness, the present story “Nidra” is a significant story.

informal_english: This paper zeroes in on figuring out where gender stands in the story “Nidra.” The story “Nidra” is a historically rooted tale picked by Nepal's Ministry of Education Curriculum Development Center for the mandatory 9th-grade Nepali textbook. Gender studies digs into the social and cultural situation of women, men, and non-binary genders in literature. The whole point is that socially and culturally speaking, nobody should be treated any differently based on gender. Ever since the feminist movement picked up steam in the 1960s, you can really see gender awareness taking off. Gender studies covers big topics like feminism, patriarchy, social gender, sexuality, masculinity, gender discrimination, and body politics. In this paper, while setting up the theory behind gender studies, what does the gender dynamic actually look like in “Nidra”? It investigates how the characters’ gender roles play out in the story. To write the paper, materials were rounded up through library research. The data was gathered and broken down using qualitative research methods. The story “Nidra” is set right inside the Rana palace. Throughout the story, you can see that even in the high-society families of that era, women's voices got sidelined by male ego and control. When it comes to the characters, the men are definitely given a stronger presence than the women. Even though her role isn't given the upper hand, the female character comes off as completely fearless when it comes to standing up for who she is. All in all, the takeaway is that when you look at it through the lens of gender awareness, “Nidra” is a really meaningful story.
